# kapp

`cata` applies this cluster's manifests, with kapp.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| waitTimeout | string | `"10m"` | How long an apply may take to settle before it is called failed.  Belongs to whatever applies — kapp here, Argo elsewhere — rather than to the cluster or to the host: it is a property of the process doing the waiting. The host's own patience, for an API server to answer during provisioning, is `lab.clusters.<c>.waitTimeout`.  |
